_comment: Copy as config.json (or use the POJUN_CONFIG environment variable to point at another path). This file only contains the `database` and `skill_dir` keys; LLM and all other configuration comes from environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: env var POJUN_PG_DSN > this file's `database`. Two styles, pick one: (A) fill in the individual fields below; (B) set only `database.dsn` to a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Style (B): delete the `database` block above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Skill root directory (one skill per subdirectory, each containing a SKILL.md). Precedence: env var POJUN_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave empty or delete this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
